prompt: Building an Ableton Live extension with @ableton-extensions/sdk. I want a right-click action on a Session-view clip slot that downloads a WAV from a hardcoded URL (https://example.com/loop.wav) and drops it into that clip slot as an unwarped audio clip. Give me the full src/extension.ts. It needs to respect the extension filesystem rules.
assertions: Entry point: exports activate and calls initialize(activation, "1.0.0")
Resolves the clip slot with getObjectFromHandle(..., ClipSlot)
Writes the download into context.environment.tempDirectory (sandbox), not an arbitrary path
Imports via context.resources.importIntoProject(...) before creating the clip
Creates the clip with clipSlot.createAudioClip({ filePath, isWarped: false })
Avoids hallucinated FS / clip API (no context.filesystem, importAudioFile, or .addAction)
